process_area.title: Milestone Inspection, Joint Quantity Survey & Escrow Draw Processing

value_stream.name: B2B Project Financing, Escrow Account Orchestration & Lien Release

fields.Trigger: Material delivery to project job site (VS-74); delivery completion

workflows.name: Project Material Goods Delivery Receipt (DR) Matching & Verification

Automation Opportunity: - Mobile app barcode scanning and automatic document matching in ERP.
Controls: - CTL-774: Original signed DR archived; matching verified by AR supervisor before invoicing release.
Cross-references: - links to VS-06 (logistics), VS-56 (3PL), VS-16 (O2C), VS-04 (DC ops)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Missing / Unsigned DRs**: Bank rejecting escrow draw requests due to lack of proof of delivery; mitigated by driver mobile photo-uploads at drop-off.
System Touchpoints: - Fleet management system (VS-06), WMS dispatch (VS-04), B2B billing ledger (VS-16).

steps.activity: Receive signed original Goods Delivery Receipts (DR) from returning drivers.
Inspect DR: verify contractor site engineer signature, stamp, date, and items accepted.
Match DR to ERP billing invoice: verify SKU codes and quantities match.
Attach scanned copy of signed DR and photo of delivered materials at site (GPS-tagged) to ERP invoice record.

fields.Frequency: Monthly or bi-weekly depending on contract
fields.Participants: Bank Inspector, General Contractor Site Engineer, Geodetic Engineer (VS-115)
fields.Trigger: Project materials delivery matching (W5209); scheduled bank inspection date

workflows.name: Bank Inspector Joint Quantity Survey (JQS) Staging & Schedule Coordination

Automation Opportunity: - JQS scheduling workflow tool with email alerts.
Controls: - CTL-774: JQS worksheet signed by all three parties (Inspector, Contractor, BuildRight) at site; discrepancies resolved.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Inspector audit failure**: Discrepancies between billed quantities and physical site inventory; mitigated by pre-inspection audit checks by BuildRight site team.
System Touchpoints: - Inspection calendar portal, technical specs database, scale logs (VS-115).

steps.activity: Review scheduled inspection dates with the developer and bank escrow agent.
Compile Joint Quantity Survey (JQS) folder: list all materials delivered, invoices, and matching delivery receipts.
Schedule joint site walk-through with Bank Inspector, Contractor Site Engineer, and BuildRight representative.
Conduct site audit: inspect delivered materials, measure quantities (lumber yard, rebar count, tile boxes), and address inspector queries.

fields.Participants: AR Specialist, Corporate Secretary (VS-36), Developer Accountant
fields.Trigger: Signed JQS worksheets (W5210) and billing invoice matching (W5209)

workflows.name: Escrow Draw Request Documentation Assembly & Submission

Automation Opportunity: - Automated draw package compiler merging invoices and DRs into a single PDF.
Controls: - CTL-774 (ensure controlled execution — Milestone Inspection, Joint Quantity Survey & Escrow Draw Processing (PA-181.2).)
- CTL-774: Draw package reviewed and signed off by Finance Controller before portal upload.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Draw package rejection**: Small formatting errors or missing papers causing bank to reject the package, delaying payments; mitigated by mandatory document checker checklist.
System Touchpoints: - Escrow portal, ERP AR module (VS-16), Board document portal (VS-36).

steps.activity: Compile the formal Escrow Draw Request package: JQS worksheets, signed DRs, tax declaration clearance, invoice bills, and progress photos.
Secure corporate signatures: draft Board Resolution or Secretary's Certificate authorizing the draw sign-off (VS-36).
Validate banking details: match target wire destination to BuildRight mapped trust account (W5204).
Submit complete draw request folder to the Bank Escrow Agent through the integrated portal (W5207).

fields.Participants: Bank Escrow Auditor, Developer Finance Director, Legal Operations (VS-100)
fields.Trigger: Draw request submission (W5211); bank agent audit request

workflows.name: Bank Escrow Agent Inspector Audits & Deviation Clarification

Controls: - CTL-774: Written audit justifications signed by Technical Director; contract modifications legal-approved.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Draw request rejected**: Bank auditor blocks entire payment due to minor item dispute; mitigated by negotiating partial draw release while investigating disputed items.
System Touchpoints: - Escrow portal, Technical specifications database, Legal database (VS-100).

steps.activity: Monitor draw request status on the bank portal; review comments or clarification requests from bank auditors.
Address audit deviations: verify quantity calculations, provide technical specifications of materials (e.g. steel grades, wood certification), or explain delivery variations.
Coordinate additional site inspections if requested by the bank auditor to verify disputed items.
Negotiate settlement for disputed items: arrange credit note adjustment or split billing if necessary.

fields.Owner: Accounts Receivable Specialist / Cash Application Clerk
fields.Participants: Treasury Operations (VS-18), bank teller, B2B Controller

workflows.name: Escrow Draw Fund Settlement Tracking, Cash Application & Match Reconciliation

Automation Opportunity: - ERP automated cash matching rules clearing invoices upon bank credit detection.
Controls: - CTL-774 (ensure controlled execution — Milestone Inspection, Joint Quantity Survey & Escrow Draw Processing (PA-181.2).)
- CTL-774: Daily cash reconciliation audited by Treasury supervisor; matching discrepancies reviewed.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unapplied cash**: Incoming funds sitting in clearing accounts due to missing reference tags; mitigated by automated cash application rules matching project trust IDs.
System Touchpoints: - Bank feed MT940 (VS-18), ERP Cash Application module (VS-16), GL AR ledger.

fields.Participants: AR Specialist, Developer Project Manager, Finance controller
fields.Trigger: Project contract execution (W5201) specifying retainage; project milestone achievement

workflows.name: Project Retainage (Milestone Retention Money) Accounting & Release Tracking

Controls: - CTL-774 (ensure controlled execution — Milestone Inspection, Joint Quantity Survey & Escrow Draw Processing (PA-181.2).)
- CTL-774: Retainage releases signed off by Corporate Controller; final ledger balances reconciled to zero.
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.1 (GL close), VS-16 (O2C), VS-166 (license portfolio)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Retainage unpaid / Delayed release**: Developer withholding retention funds due to minor defects, inflating DSO; mitigated by clear contract resolution clauses and defect warranty offsets.
System Touchpoints: - ERP GL retainage ledger (VS-17.1), AR billing database (VS-16), LGU permit tracking (VS-166).
Time Estimate: - ~2-3 hours monthly review; 5-10 days release process

steps.activity: Set up the Project Retainage subsidiary ledger: configure 5% to 10% auto-deduction from project invoices to retainage ledger.
Perform monthly retention reconciliation: track accumulated retainage balance against project milestones.
Prepare retainage release documentation: compile Certificate of Practical Completion, LGU occupancy permit, and final clear-title waiver.
Submit release request to bank escrow agent; follow up on cash release and clear the retainage ledger balance.

fields.Owner: Director of Legal Operations (VS-100) / Credit Manager
fields.Participants: Developer Legal Counsel, Bank Trust Representative, CFO, B2B VP
fields.Trigger: Draw request rejection or payment freeze by bank/developer (W5212)

workflows.name: Project Escrow Payment Dispute, Resolution & Negotiation

Controls: - CTL-774 (ensure controlled execution — Milestone Inspection, Joint Quantity Survey & Escrow Draw Processing (PA-181.2).)
- CTL-774: Settlement agreement signed by CFO; adjustments approved by Controller.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Litigation delay**: Unsettled disputes freezing escrow funds for months; mitigated by mandatory arbitration clauses in contract onboarding templates.
System Touchpoints: - Legal case portal (VS-100), ERP AR adjustments screen (VS-16).

workflows.name: Project Progress Billing Status Dashboard & Cashflow Forecast

Automation Opportunity: - Automated data pull and chart generation in BI tool.
Controls: - CTL-774 (ensure controlled execution — Milestone Inspection, Joint Quantity Survey & Escrow Draw Processing (PA-181.2).)
- CTL-774: Cash forecasting model approved by Treasurer; variance review completed monthly.
Pain Points / Risks: - **Inaccurate forecasting**: Overestimating escrow draw speed, causing short-term liquidity issues; mitigated by using historical draw speed baselines (e.g. average 25 days) rather than theoretical milestones.
System Touchpoints: - ERP BI analytics dashboard (VS-28), Treasury cash forecasting module (VS-18), GL AR ledger.
